description: Flat metadata schema for individual metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) records derived from marine microbial communities, including collection context, environmental conditions, processing methods, sequencing, assembly, and quality assessment.

mag_record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the MAG record or bin within the dataset.

sample_id.descr: Identifier of the original environmental sample from which the MAG was recovered.

collection_site_name.descr: Name of the marine sampling site, station, cruise location, or expedition site.

ocean_basin_or_sea.descr: Ocean basin, sea, or marine region where the sample was collected (e.g., Atlantic Ocean, Mediterranean Sea).

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees; use negative values for south.

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees; use negative values for west.

collection_depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters below the sea surface.

collection_datetime.descr: Date of sample collection, ideally in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or full timestamp if available).

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ seawater temperature in degrees Celsius at the time/depth of sampling.

salinity_psu.descr: Salinity of the sampled water in practical salinity units (PSU).

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in milligrams per liter (mg/L).

ph.descr: Measured pH of the seawater sample.

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration in micrograms per liter (µg/L), if measured.

nitrate_umol_l.descr: Nitrate concentration in micromoles per liter (µmol/L), if measured.

phosphate_umol_l.descr: Phosphate concentration in micromoles per liter (µmol/L), if measured.

silicate_umol_l.descr: Silicate concentration in micromoles per liter (µmol/L), if measured.

sample_collection_method.descr: Description of how the marine sample was collected (e.g., Niskin bottle, rosette sampler, in situ filtration).

water_filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size used to collect microbial biomass, in micrometers (µm).

biomass_concentration_method.descr: Method used to concentrate biomass prior to DNA extraction, if applicable.

dna_extraction_kit_or_protocol.descr: DNA extraction kit, protocol, or laboratory workflow used to obtain nucleic acids.

chemical_lysis_method.descr: Chemical cell disruption approach used for extraction (e.g., SDS, lysozyme, proteinase K), if applicable.

mechanical_lysis_method.descr: Mechanical disruption approach used for extraction (e.g., bead beating, sonication), if applicable.

bead_beating_time_s.descr: Duration of bead-beating treatment in seconds, if used.

bead_beating_frequency_hz.descr: Bead-beating or homogenization frequency in hertz (Hz), if applicable.

dna_library_preparation_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used before sequencing.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used (e.g., Illumina, PacBio, Oxford Nanopore).

sequencing_instrument_model.descr: Specific sequencing instrument model (e.g., NovaSeq 6000, HiSeq X, PromethION).

sequencing_read_type.descr: Read configuration used for sequencing (e.g., paired-end, single-end, long-read).

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs (bp), typically for short-read data.

insert_size_bp.descr: Approximate library insert size in base pairs (bp), if applicable.

sequencing_coverage_x.descr: Approximate sequencing depth/coverage for the MAG in-fold coverage (X), if known.

raw_read_accession.descr: Accession or identifier for the raw sequencing reads in a public repository, if available.

quality_filtering_software.descr: Software used for read quality control and trimming prior to assembly.

quality_filtering_version.descr: Version of the quality filtering software.

assembly_software.descr: Primary assembler used to generate contigs from metagenomic reads (e.g., MEGAHIT, metaSPAdes).

assembly_parameters.descr: Key assembly parameters or command-line options relevant for reproduction.

polishing_software.descr: Software used to polish or correct assembled contigs, if applicable.

binning_software.descr: Software used to bin contigs into MAGs (e.g., MetaBAT2, CONCOCT, MaxBin2).

binning_strategy.descr: Description of the binning strategy, including single-sample or differential coverage binning.

quality_assessment_tool.descr: Tool used to assess MAG completeness and contamination (e.g., CheckM, BUSCO).

quality_assessment_version.descr: Version of the quality assessment tool.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness as a percentage (0-100).

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated genome contamination as a percentage (0-100).

strain_heterogeneity_percent.descr: Estimated strain heterogeneity as a percentage, if reported.

genome_quality_category.descr: Quality category for the MAG (e.g., high-quality, medium-quality, low-quality) according to the study or standards used.

contig_count.descr: Number of contigs/scaffolds in the MAG.

total_assembly_size_bp.descr: Total assembled genome size in base pairs (bp).

n50_bp.descr: N50 contig length in base pairs (bp).

largest_contig_bp.descr: Length of the largest contig in base pairs (bp).

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the MAG as a percentage (0-100).

taxonomy_domain.descr: Taxonomic domain assigned to the MAG (e.g., Bacteria, Archaea).

taxonomy_species.descr: Species-level classification or closest species name, if assigned.

ecological_role_annotation.descr: Brief description of the inferred ecological role or functional niche of the MAG in the marine ecosystem.

functional_annotation_pipeline.descr: Software or pipeline used for gene prediction and functional annotation.

functional_annotation_version.descr: Version of the functional annotation pipeline.

mag_is_high_quality.descr: True if the MAG meets the study's high-quality threshold; otherwise false.

mag_is_redundant_with_other_bin.descr: True if this MAG is redundant with another bin or dereplicated representative; otherwise false.

notes.descr: Free-text notes on unusual processing steps, exceptions, or important caveats for this MAG record.
